hints.title: Post-Order Subtree Deletion
hints.text: A node can be removed if both of its subtrees are empty and its own value is zero.

hints.title: Bottom Up Pruning
hints.text: Process left and right child subtrees before inspecting the current parent node.

hints.title: Conditional Node Nullification
hints.text: Recursively prune left and right subtrees. If both subtrees become null and current node value is zero, return null to detach the node.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Post-order DFS visiting every tree node once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Top-down inspection cannot determine whether descendant leaves contain ones without full repeated traversals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursion stack scales with tree height H.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Post-order bottom-up nullification returning the pruned root reference.
